deadline.value: January 10, 2027 (later applications accepted but processed after)
deadline.quote: The deadline for the application is January 10, 2027.

gre_subject.quote: General GRE (Verbal, Quantitative, and Analytical Writing) and Subject GRE (Physics) test scores are not required for applications.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the department's Graduate Admissions Committee; no advisor is assigned at admission and students build ties with faculty in their first year.
supervisor.quote: will a research advisor be appointed for me? No. Students are encouraged to begin building relationships with faculty in their field of interest their first year | The Graduate Admissions Committee will happily pass on your inquiries to the appropriate research group.

funding.value: Most newly admitted students get a Teaching Assistantship with full or partial tuition remission; standard TA positions do not cover university fees (about $1,200 a semester).
funding.quote: Most newly admitted students will receive a Teaching Assistantship plus full or partial tuition remission from the department. | The vast majority receive support.

also.quote: nearly all admitted graduate students are offered to take advantage of one of several potential opportunities to provide for their tuition and living expenses

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is the minimum; most successful applicants majored in physics.
entry_route.quote: At least a Bachelor’s degree, with official academic transcripts

app_fee.quote: The application fee for domestic students is $89, while international students pay $114.

fee_waiver.value: Automatic waiver for Pell Grant or McNair recipients (U.S. programs); no international route stated on the pages checked
fee_waiver.quote: If you are the recipient of a Pell Grant or a McNair Scholarship, you automatically qualify for an application fee waiver.

gre_general.quote: General GRE (Verbal, Quantitative, and Analytical Writing) and Subject GRE (Physics) test scores are not required for applications.

notes: Physics and Astronomy use separate application forms. Decisions must be returned by April 15.
